elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Just closed the tab you actually needed? Again?

[confident] Here's the fix. Press Control, Shift, T.

[friendly] Your tab comes right back. On a Mac, it's Command, Shift, T. Keep pressing to bring back more.

[delighted] Nothing you close is really gone.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
